subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the underlined word.

He walked __leisurely__ towards the entrance.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"leisurely"** means without haste, in a relaxed and unhurried manner. (बिना जल्दी के)

 
 
• **Example:** They enjoyed a leisurely walk in the park on Sunday afternoon.
 
 
 
• **"Without haste" **indicates doing something slowly and calmly, taking one's time. (बिना जल्दी के)
 
 
• **Example:** She completed the task without haste, ensuring everything was perfect.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the meaning of **'leisurely' **is **'without haste'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Reassuringly **(आश्वस्त करते हुए): In a way that removes someone’s doubts and fears.

 
 
• **Example:** He spoke reassuringly to calm her nerves before the interview.
 
 
 
• **With a kickstart **(एकदम से): To start something energetically or suddenly.
 
 
• **Example:** The team began their project with a kickstart, full of enthusiasm.
 
 
 
• **Hastily** (जल्दी में): Doing something quickly, often with little thought or planning.
 
 
• **Example:** She packed her bags hastily, eager to catch the early morning train.
